sessions.name: Lower Body + Anti-Rotation Core
sessions.focus: Posterior chain, hip stability, spine-safe anti-rotation core — no spinal flexion under load
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 11kg, 8x TRX split squat per leg, 15x banded glute bridge (pause 1s at top), 2x20m farmer's carry 2x6kg, 10x Pallof press per side (light band, hold 2s). 60-90s rest between rounds. No spinal flexion under load. Posture over load throughout.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and side, hip circles, 10x bodyweight squat, 10x bodyweight glute bridge

Rest between rounds — walk around, breathe, check posture for next round
